root_cause: liveSse.ts and agora/workshops.ts EventSource pre-open error handlers called refreshBffSession and only reconnected on refreshed=true. Since #901 a transient refresh failure (404/5xx/network) returns false without logout, so the stream stayed dead until reload.
fix: sessionExpiry.ts: new refreshBffSessionOutcome() returning refreshed | auth_rejected | transient; refreshBffSession() is a boolean wrapper (unchanged behavior).
liveSse.ts: pre-open failure + transient refresh -> backoff reconnect using module attempt counter; auth_rejected -> no reconnect; post-open drops still skip refresh.

workshops.ts: post-open drop -> backoff reconnect without refresh; pre-open failure -> refresh, onError still reported, backoff reconnect on transient, none on 401/403. Attempt resets on open/refresh success; timer cleared on cleanup.

verification.vitest: npx vitest run src/lib/bff-v1 src/lib/auth: 64 files, 671 tests passed (new: sse.test.ts x2, workshops.test.ts x3 covering unreachable-then-reachable, growing backoff, 401/403 no reconnect, post-open no refresh)
